question: According to the Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025, within how many days can an appeal be made in the High Court on the order of the Waqf Tribunal?
solution: The correct answer is __**90 days**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025** introduces reforms to enhance the transparency and efficiency of Waqf Boards and Tribunals in India. • According to the provisions of this amendment, any person aggrieved by the decision of the **Waqf Tribunal** can file an appeal in the respective **High Court**. • The time period for filing such an appeal has been specifically set at **90 days** from the date of the Tribunal’s order. • This 90-day period ensures that parties have a reasonable amount of time to prepare their case and approach the High Court for justice. • By setting a uniform timeline, the amendment aims to standardize legal proceedings and reduce delays in addressing disputes related to **Waqf properties**.
